answer: Probe responsiveness to protocol perturbations: each epoch the network injects small randomized changes, and records how each identity adapts. One operator running many puppets applies fixes in lockstep, so every clone's adaptation curve bends at the same epoch with the same patch, a visibly grafted terrace of identical responses. Genuinely independent agents absorb change differently, some fast, some stumbling, like a scattered lotus opening at uneven hours. Score per-address adaptation lag variance; clones converge too tightly and lose emission, while the honest yarrow of diversity profits.
